heard: Moses wrote the song that day, he taught the people what to say The Lord spoke to Joshua, son of Nun, be strong and brave, the work is done I will bring them into the land, I swore to give with my own hand I myself shall be with you there, no fear shall cloud your solemn care Take this book of the law, place it by the ark forever It stands as a witness against you For I know your hearts are few, rebellious and stiff-necked Is your way, even now in my life today When the writing was finished completely From the first verse to the final beat He gave the command to the lead
